# ShadowPlay
> Real-Time Browser Hand Shadow Puppet Recognition Studio

## Summary
ShadowPlay is an interactive, browser-based computer vision application that recognizes hand shadow gestures via webcam and renders animated vector silhouette puppets onto a virtual projection surface in real time.

## Key Principles & Technology
- Privacy First Architecture: Hand tracking (Google MediaPipe Hands) runs strictly client-side via WebAssembly in browser RAM. Webcam video frames are never transmitted, recorded, or uploaded to any remote server.
- Supported Hand Gestures: 21 anatomical silhouette shapes across animals (Rabbit, Dog, Bird, Butterfly, Snake, Goat, Fox, Horse, Spider, Donkey, Pig, Lizard, Eagle, Deer) and objects (Scissors, Glasses, Cup, Crown, Airplane, Heart, Sword).
- Frontend Stack: React 18, HTML5 Canvas API, Web Audio API, Web Speech API, Vanilla CSS.
- Backend Stack: Node.js, Express, MongoDB (minimal anonymous session tracking and leaderboard).

## Legal & Compliance
- Data Minimization: Anonymous random UUID stored in browser localStorage. No personally identifiable information (PII) required.
- India DPDP Act 2023: Full data principal rights supported (access, correction, erasure).
- Privacy Policy: https://shadowplay.app/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://shadowplay.app/terms
- Cookie Policy: https://shadowplay.app/cookies
- Grievance Redressal: grievance@shadowplay.app
